tokens.npc_dota_hero_centaur_bio:
It's said that a centaur's road is paved with the corpses of the fallen. For the one called Warrunner, it has been a long road indeed. To outsiders, the four-legged clans of Druud are often mistaken for simple, brutish creatures. Their language has no written form; their culture lacks pictographic traditions, structured music, formalized religion. For centaurs, combat is the perfect articulation of thought, the highest expression of self. If killing is an art among centaurs, then Bradwarden the Warrunner is their greatest artist. He rose to dominance on the proving grounds of Omexe, an ancient arena where centaur clans have for millennia gathered to perform their gladiatorial rites. As his fame spread, spectators came from far and wide to see the great centaur in action. Always the first to step into the arena, and the last to leave, he composes a masterpiece in each guttering spray, each thrust of blood-slickened blade-length. It is the poetry of blood on steel, flung in complex patterns across the pale sands of the killing floor.

Warrunner defeated warrior after warrior, until the arena boomed with the cheering of his name, and he found himself alone, the uncontested champion of his kind. The great belt of Omexe was bestowed, wrapped around his broad torso, but in his victory, the death-artist found only emptiness. For what is a warrior without a challenge? The great centaur galloped out of Omexe that day with a new goal. To his people, Warrunner is the greatest warrior to ever step into the arena. Now he has set out to prove he is the greatest fighter who has ever lived.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_centaur_hype: Centaur Warrunner is a master of both inflicting and absorbing damage. Leading the charge into battle, he stomps to stun his enemies, and instantly counters their every attack. His stampede speeds his allies in both fight and flight, quickening the pace of the carnage.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_centaur_npedesc1: Reflects damage back to his attackers

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Replaces {{A|Centaur Warrunner|Work Horse}} up until any of the following conditions are met:
** This {{M|sub-ability}} is used.
** The allied hero is dismounted from Hitch A Ride.
** The cart duration ends.

* [[File:Dota2 Centaur Warrunner Hitch Cart icon.png|21px|Cart Properties]]
** Has a total {{#var:Hitch A Ride value3}}-second duration upon casting {{A|Centaur Warrunner|Work Horse}}.
** Hitch A Ride does not increase the cast duration.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}} {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Centaur Warrunner Hitch Cart icon.png|21px|Cart Properties]] {{hi|Centaur Warrunner}}
** Does not {{M|disjoint}} incoming {{M|projectiles}} toward the allied hero while mounting the affected hero.
** {{M|Teleports}} the affected allied hero into the cart, in a ≈110-height arc and varying lengths onto the cart, over 0.5 seconds.
** Applies the following ability effects to the allied hero within the cart:
*** {{M|Phase movement}}
*** {{M|Root}}
*** {{M|Invulnerable}}
*** {{M|Untargetable|text=Untargetability}}
**** Certain abilities may [[Non-targetable#Bypassing Unselectability|bypass unselectability]] conditionally, whereas almost every other ability treats the mounted allied hero as if it were {{M|invisible|x}}.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
** Enemy attacks while in its {{M|attack animation}} are canceled.
** Enemy abilities targeting the mounted ally while in its {{M|cast animation}} are canceled.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** If Centaur {{M|teleports}} {{Code|> {{#var:Hitch A Ride value3}}-distance}}, the allied hero is dismounted and the cart disappears.
** The cart does not disappear when Centaur is affected by {{M|hidden}} sources.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
** {{M|Disable Help}} on Centaur Warrunner prevents Hitch a Ride from affecting the allied hero.
** The following sources may dismount the affected allied hero:
*** Centaur or the allied hero's {{M|teleport}} sources; this includes a 0-range {{M|teleport|x}}.
*** Upon Centaur or the allied hero's {{M|death}}.
*** Affected by certain {{M|forced movement|x}} sources.

* Has the following priority among {{M|forced movement}} sources:
*# {{A|Primal Beast|Pulverize}}
*# {{A|Tusk|Walrus PUNCH!}} and {{A|Tusk|Walrus Kick}}.
*# {{A|Keeper of the Light|Will-O-Wisp}}
*# Hitch A Ride
*# Other {{M|forced movement|x}} sources.

*** The mounted allied hero is ≈80 distance above the ground.
*** The z-axis of units with {{M|flying movement}} will have a height of {{cf|expr}} {{Code|CartHeight + AscendingHeight}} when mounted on the cart.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_centaur
data.bio_loc:
It's said that a centaur's road is paved with the corpses of the fallen. For the one called Warrunner, it has been a long road indeed. To outsiders, the four-legged clans of Druud are often mistaken for simple, brutish creatures. Their language has no written form; their culture lacks pictographic traditions, structured music, formalized religion. For centaurs, combat is the perfect articulation of thought, the highest expression of self. If killing is an art among centaurs, then Bradwarden the Warrunner is their greatest artist. He rose to dominance on the proving grounds of Omexe, an ancient arena where centaur clans have for millennia gathered to perform their gladiatorial rites. As his fame spread, spectators came from far and wide to see the great centaur in action. Always the first to step into the arena, and the last to leave, he composes a masterpiece in each guttering spray, each thrust of blood-slickened blade-length. It is the poetry of blood on steel, flung in complex patterns across the pale sands of the killing floor.

Warrunner defeated warrior after warrior, until the arena boomed with the cheering of his name, and he found himself alone, the uncontested champion of his kind. The great belt of Omexe was bestowed, wrapped around his broad torso, but in his victory, the death-artist found only emptiness. For what is a warrior without a challenge? The great centaur galloped out of Omexe that day with a new goal. To his people, Warrunner is the greatest warrior to ever step into the arena. Now he has set out to prove he is the greatest fighter who has ever lived.
data.hype_loc: Centaur Warrunner is a master of both inflicting and absorbing damage. Leading the charge into battle, he stomps to stun his enemies, and instantly counters their every attack. His stampede speeds his allies in both fight and flight, quickening the pace of the carnage.

abilities.lore_loc: It is a great honor to be offered a ride by Centaur Warrunner and a grave mistake to refuse it.

abilities.name: centaur_stampede
abilities.desc_loc: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.
abilities.lore_loc: The great belt of Omexe, which labels Bradwarden as the greatest warrior of his kind, incites his fellow gladiators to follow him into barbarous combat.

abilities.name: centaur_horsepower
abilities.desc_loc:
Centaur Warrunner gains %strength_to_movement_pct%%% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_centaur_1
talents.desc_loc: Allied heroes within 1200 range of Centaur gain the Return Damage aspect of Retaliate.

officialDataset.interpretation: Official website declarations, retained in full; not an assertion of complete engine verification.
